summary: Jack of all trades IT professional with extensive experience in systems, network, and end‑user support at a leading intellectual property law school. Self‑motivated, detail‑oriented, and organized, thrives on creatively solving new challenges.

experience.title: Information Technology Administrator
responsibilities: Oversaw purchasing, management, and maintenance of infrastructure hardware and software.
Supported end‑user hardware/software for ~85 faculty/staff and 275 students.
Managed a 5‑host, 40‑server VMWare farm and maintained help desk, network monitoring, security, ID card, printing, and electronic exam systems.
Backed up critical data on the UNH Law network and administered fileservers, webservers, and CMS.
Collaborated with Durham campus, IT vendors, and BSC office to develop IT budget and policies.

experience.title: Associate Director of Computer Services
responsibilities: Provided end‑user support for mixed Windows, Mac, Linux, and Novell environments.
Maintained campus network with Cisco infrastructure.
Designed and implemented the first wireless network and led its upgrades.
Planned and executed Windows and Mac OS upgrades.
Managed transition from Novell to Microsoft infrastructure and migrated email from GroupWise to Exchange.

experience.title: District Computer Technician
responsibilities: Supported end‑user hardware/software for the entire school district.
Implemented the first Apple Airport WiFi network and roaming iBook lab.

experience.title: Electrician's Apprentice
responsibilities: Performed industrial electrical work in manufacturing and residential settings.
